long_biography.plain_text:
Businessman Paul McDonald established Fortrus Pastoral near Gympie as a cattle breeding enterprise. His family assembled several properties around Bells Bridge and acquired the Angle Zed Droughtmaster stud, adding an established herd to the operation. In 2012, Fortrus bought Glenlands Prince, an interbreed champion bull, for a price that set a Droughtmaster breed record.

The family's breeding choices subsequently changed. After dispersing its Droughtmaster herd in 2015, Fortrus switched to Brangus before returning to Droughtmasters for their temperament, tolerance of flies and performance on the property. Fortrus has also combined artificial insemination with a bull selected to serve its heifers after the insemination programme.
long_biography.html:
Businessman Paul McDonald established Fortrus Pastoral near Gympie as a cattle breeding enterprise. His family assembled several properties around Bells Bridge and acquired the Angle Zed Droughtmaster stud, adding an established herd to the operation. In 2012, Fortrus bought Glenlands Prince, an interbreed champion bull, for a price that set a Droughtmaster breed record.

The family's breeding choices subsequently changed. After dispersing its Droughtmaster herd in 2015, Fortrus switched to Brangus before returning to Droughtmasters for their temperament, tolerance of flies and performance on the property. Fortrus has also combined artificial insemination with a bull selected to serve its heifers after the insemination programme.

Multiple contemporary reports identify his quarry, resource and pastoral businesses.
